title: Accessibility Labels from Data
hints: Describe meaning, not symbols: stars → "rated 4.2 out of 5".

jsBridge: VoiceOver reads `accessibilityLabel`s, so a row showing `★★★★☆ 4.2 $19.99 🔥` needs a spoken label like "Rated 4.2 out of 5, 19 dollars 99, popular". It's ARIA `aria-label` for native views.

Label vs value vs hint vs traits: which carries "4.2 stars", and which carries "double-tap to buy"?
